microbenchmark.method:
# PR #517 planar loop experiment

Frozen input source is planar-raw.ts / optimize-raw.ts. `prepare.mjs` transpiles exact baseline and three private candidates using the repository TypeScript package. No repository source is changed by any reproduction script.

Reproduce (from any directory):

```sh
node /tmp/pr517-planar-experiment/prepare.mjs
node /tmp/pr517-planar-experiment/bench.mjs
node /tmp/pr517-planar-experiment/bench.mjs combined
node /tmp/pr517-planar-experiment/shared-bench.mjs combined
bash /tmp/pr517-planar-experiment/cold.sh
```

The three warm commands all perform 4 warmup pairs then 12 alternating measured pairs on 350² plane, constant-color plane, 992016-vertex closedBox, curved-color, and planar color seam. `bench.mjs` compares separately compiled optimize modules; shared-bench additionally uses the identical indexMesh function for both alternatives to isolate unchanged indexing JIT/allocator noise. `planar` phase always receives the same preindexed source mesh. `equal` compares each complete output stream byte-for-byte and root metadata, plus SHA256 including all output buffers/metadata. Hash computation and equality occur outside measured intervals. All outputs matched.

Archived warm results with every pair/hash:

- initial-results.json: all three candidates, initial run.
- repeat-results.json: independent combined-only fresh process repeat.
- shared-index-results.json: unchanged index function shared by both alternatives.

Combined plane planar medians across these three runs: 29.766→24.854 ms (16.5%); 27.947→24.408 ms (12.7%); 28.841→24.938 ms (13.5%). Candidate won 12/12, 11/12, and 11/12 planar pairs. Complete preparation plane medians: 56.119→52.909 ms (5.7%); 57.228→52.343 ms (8.5%); 58.042→55.845 ms (3.8%). Constant-color plane planar improvements were 7.1%, 6.6%, 16.1%; full preparation improvements14.7%,4.7%,4.6%. Color seam planar scan improved about43% but complete preparation only4–9%.

Full closedBox medians fluctuated24.973→24.655 ms,23.993→25.331 ms,25.120→23.795 ms; its changed-code region is never reached and planar rejection medians stayed around0.054ms for both implementations (each6/12 planar pair wins). Curved-color full medians varied less than0.3%; submicrosecond planar values are timer noise and provide no useful percentage comparison. The shared unchanged-index follow-up showed no full control regression.

Fresh Node first-call phases are cold-results.ndjson (every process/hash), summarized in cold-summary.json. Four alternating fresh-process pairs each for plane, closedBox, curved-color. Plane median index32.902→33.379 ms, planar54.520→50.470 ms (7.4%), total86.187→83.461 ms (3.2%). ClosedBox total43.627→43.480 ms; curved-color9.197→8.696 ms. Control planar first calls were slightly slower by0.069ms/0.010ms, below useful scale for these4-pair samples and compensated by unchanged-index variation. These are Node first-call phase timings, with fixture construction and module import outside measurement. They are not browser-import, Worker startup, or first-display evidence.

Retained source is combined-planar.ts. It changes only constant attribute scalar checking to triplets (cooperative deadline observations every4095 scalar positions) and caches three triangle indices for the unchanged robust orient2d/edge hash loop. No new array allocations; orientations, area arithmetic order, insertion order,32-probe guard, certification, tolerances, output construction, admission and original deadline value remain unchanged. The scalar attribute tail preserves behavior for incomplete triplets.

After main conditional authorization, applied the combined source to repository planar.ts and added one semantic test for previously uncovered successful distinct-component RGB tuples and mixed signed-zero normals. Targeted `pnpm exec vitest run test/geometry-optimization.test.ts` passed13/13 tests in2.81s. No commits/pushes performed by this agent.

source.cold.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
output=/tmp/pr517-planar-experiment/cold-results.ndjson
: > "$output"
for fixture in plane closedBox curved-color; do
  for pair in 0 1 2 3; do
    if ((pair % 2)); then order='combined baseline'; else order='baseline combined'; fi
    for variant in $order; do
      node /tmp/pr517-planar-experiment/cold.mjs child "$variant" "$fixture" >> "$output"
    done
  done
done
cat "$output"
